description: Home besiege a low block, finally break through, then get hit by a counter-attack against the run of play before settling it late.

phases.label: home_siege
phases.description: Home camp in the away half; away defend in a compact low block.

phases.label: away_low_block
phases.description: Away drop off and defend their box.

phases.label: away_counter_burst
phases.description: Away break quickly after winning the ball, at pace and with directness.

scripted_goals.description: Home finally break the low block.
Away score on the counter, against the run of play.
